pin_regs.reason: ot_hbm_rly IS one register stage by contract (r <= i, o = r): its single flop per bit is the pin register; extra input/output pin registers would make the die relay 3 cycles and break the compiled static schedule. The flop is anchored at the OUTPUT pin (OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE ^o), the input pin keeps its HB2 pad + BUFx4f driver.
